environment.description: AWS Lambda function behind API Gateway (REST API, proxy integration) with Lambda proxy passthrough enabled. API Gateway is configured with no request validation, binary media type passthrough for all content types (*/*). The function URL is publicly accessible. CloudFront distribution in front with default cache behavior, no origin request policy modifications. No Content-Security-Policy headers are added at any layer. The analytics_src parameter in /render endpoint accepts arbitrary URLs without validation.

config.api_gateway: REST API, proxy integration, no request validators
config.cloudfront: default cache behavior, no response headers policy
